title: custom axe (forest)
description: A Minecraft Java Edition resource pack that replaces the Netherite Axe with a custom 3D model of a "Forest Axe". Created with Blockbench, compatible with Pack Format 34 (Minecraft 1.21.x).
body:
##3D Forest Axe  Netherite Axe Retexture


A handcrafted 3D resource pack that transforms the Netherite Axe into a rustic forest axe with a fully custom model and two-layer texturing. Features smooth organic curves and a bold cel-shaded outline for a stylized, toon-inspired look. Works seamlessly in first-person, third-person, inventory, and item frames.
